checks.said: Top middle: slowing growth, high inflation
Rising from bottom left to middle left
Bottom left: low inflation, low growth
Top right: growth and inflation, Fed biased tight

growth.label: Industrial production
growth.desc: Output of factories, mines and utilities vs a year ago

growth.label: Payroll jobs
growth.desc: Number of jobs vs a year ago

growth.label: Real income ex-transfers
growth.desc: Household income after inflation, excluding government payments, vs a year ago

growth.label: Real business sales
growth.desc: Inflation-adjusted manufacturing, wholesale and retail sales vs a year ago (published about two months late, so lagged a month here)

growth.label: Housing starts
growth.desc: New homes being built (3-month average) vs a year ago

growth.label: Unemployment rate (inverted)
growth.desc: Change in the jobless rate over 12 months; a falling rate counts as strength

growth.label: Jobless claims (inverted)
growth.desc: New unemployment claims vs a year ago; fewer claims count as strength

growth.label: Philly Fed factory activity
growth.desc: Survey of manufacturers: share reporting more vs less activity (3-month average)

growth.label: Philly Fed new orders
growth.desc: Survey of manufacturers: share reporting more vs fewer new orders (3-month average)

inflation.label: Crude oil price
inflation.desc: Oil price vs a year ago

inflation.label: Producer prices
inflation.desc: Is producer commodity-price inflation speeding up? Change over 6 months in its yearly rate

inflation.label: Consumer prices
inflation.desc: Is consumer inflation speeding up? Change over 6 months in the yearly CPI rate

inflation.label: Hourly wages
inflation.desc: Is wage growth speeding up? Change over 6 months in its yearly rate
